Hidden Fates Shiny Vault

Released August 23, 2019 · 94 cards

Expanded

Hidden Fates Shiny Vault is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sun & Moon series, released in English on August 23, 2019. It has 94 cards. It includes 84 Pokémon, 10 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

23 illustrators worked on Hidden Fates Shiny Vault. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (42), Masakazu Fukuda (4), Saya Tsuruta (4), Shigenori Negishi (4), Shin Nagasawa (4), Akira Komayama (3), kirisAki (3), Kouki Saitou (3).
